name: Kackle

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The kackle passes through creatures and objects as though they were Difficult Terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Lantern Vulnerability
traits.summary: Its lantern (AC 15, immune to Poison and Psychic) can be hit; damage to the lantern deals half that amount as Force damage to the kackle.
traits.text: The kackle's lantern has AC 15 and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Any damage the lantern takes deals half that amount of Force damage to the kackle.

actions.name: Lantern Flame (Blue)
actions.summary: Blue flame: melee or ranged +7 (reach 5 ft, range 90 ft), 1d6+4 Cold and Restrained until the end of the target's next turn.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 feet or range 90 feet. Hit (blue lantern): 7 (1d6 + 4) Cold damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lantern Flame (Green)
actions.summary: Green flame: melee or ranged +7, 3d10+4 Necrotic and the target's Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 feet or range 90 feet. Hit (green lantern): 20 (3d10 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the target's Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lantern Flame (Purple)
actions.summary: Purple flame: melee or ranged +7, 1d12+4 Psychic and the target is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 feet or range 90 feet. Hit (purple lantern): 10 (1d12 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lantern Flame (Red)
actions.summary: Red flame: melee or ranged +7, 2d10+4 Fire and the target starts burning, taking 1d10 Fire a turn instead of the usual burning damage.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 feet or range 90 feet. Hit (red lantern): 15 (2d10 + 4) Fire damage, and the target starts burning, taking 5 (1d10) Fire damage instead of the regular burning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Flickering Teleport
bonus_actions.summary: Teleports up to 60 ft to a space it sees, then may change its lantern's color and burst a 5-ft Emanation at its destination: DC 15 Dex save, 3d8 of the current color's damage (half on a success).
bonus_actions.text: The kackle teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can then change its lantern color, and it can cause the following. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the space it arrives in. Failure: 13 (3d8) damage of the same type as the current Lantern Flame color (Cold blue, Necrotic green, Psychic purple, Fire red). Success: half damage.

summary: A cackling ghost carrying a lantern of ghost-flame whose color picks its curse (cold and bound, withering, fear or fire); it blinks about the field, and smashing its lantern hurts it.
